h1: The 8 Best Filing Cabinets for Home Offices of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Home Office Filing Cabinets: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 filing cabinets for home offices compared on drawers, locks, mobility and footprint, from under-desk rollers to lateral units.
summary: The Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet is the best for most home offices: arrives fully assembled, locks, fits letter, legal and A4 hanging files, and rolls out from under a desk. For a smaller space, the DEVAISE 2-drawer under-desk cabinet is the compact choice. The VASAGLE CUSTOS doubles as a printer stand, and the Letaya lateral model needs less front-to-back clearance.
intro: A home office filing cabinet is a space decision first. Vertical cabinets need front-to-back room to open, lateral ones need side room, and under-desk rollers need leg clearance. Buy the wrong shape and the drawers will not fully open in the spot you chose.

We reviewed eight cabinets on paper, covering vertical, lateral and rolling designs with two or three drawers. Ranking starts with how well each fits a typical home office, then locks, mobility and whether it arrives assembled, since a heavy steel cabinet is a chore to build.

products.name: Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet with Lock
products.verdict: Fully assembled, locking, three drawers, rolls out from under a desk.
products.description:
Letaya's mobile cabinet has three drawers, a locking mechanism and fits letter, legal and A4 hanging files. It arrives fully assembled and has an under-desk mobile design.

It wins because it combines the three things a home office wants: no assembly, a lock and mobility. The other cabinets each skip one.

Buy it for a desk-side file store. The caveat is that three drawers under a desk need decent clearance.
products.idealFor: Most home offices with a desk-side spot.
products.skipIf: You have no space under the desk.

products.name: DEVAISE 2 Drawer Metal File Cabinet, Fully Assembled, Under Desk, Black
products.verdict: Two locking drawers in a fully assembled metal under-desk cabinet.
products.description:
DEVAISE offers two drawers, a lock and a metal under-desk design. It arrives fully assembled and fits letter, legal and A4 hanging files.

It ranks second because it has the same convenience as the Letaya in a smaller package. It stores less, but it fits under more desks.

Best for a compact office. The caveat is only two drawers.
products.skipIf: You file a lot of paper.

products.name: Letaya 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Metal Lateral Filing Cabinet
products.verdict: A lateral metal cabinet that needs less front-to-back clearance.
products.description:
This Letaya is a lateral two-drawer metal cabinet with a lock, measuring 27.95 x 28.35 x 15.74 inches. It fits letter, legal and A4 files.

It ranks third because lateral drawers open sideways, so it works in a room where you cannot pull a deep drawer forward. It needs more width than a vertical model.

Best for a narrow room. The caveat is the wide footprint.

products.name: DEVAISE 3-Drawer Mobile File Cabinet, Lateral Filing Cabinet, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: Three lateral drawers on casters in a rustic brown finish.
products.description:
DEVAISE sells a three-drawer lateral cabinet on mobile casters in a rustic brown finish. It fits letter, legal and A4 files.

It ranks fourth because the extra drawer and brown finish suit a home-decor look, but the listing mentions no lock. It beats the Letaya lateral for storage.

Best for a decorative home office. The caveat is no stated lock.

products.name: VASAGLE CUSTOS 2-Drawer File Cabinet, Small Rolling Filing Cabinet, Matte Black
products.verdict: A 15.7 x 16.5 x 27.6 inch rolling cabinet that doubles as a printer stand.
products.description:
VASAGLE CUSTOS is a two-drawer rolling cabinet measuring 15.7 x 16.5 x 27.6 inches in matte black. It fits letter and A4 files and doubles as a printer stand.

It ranks fifth because it works in two jobs and costs the least here. It does not mention legal-size files or a lock.

Best for a printer-and-paper corner. The caveat is the missing legal-size support.

products.name: GYIIYUO 2 Drawer File Cabinet with 24 Inch Extended Desktop
products.verdict: A mobile two-drawer cabinet with a 24 inch extended desktop surface.
products.description:
GYIIYUO is a two-drawer mobile cabinet with fabric drawer fronts, a 24 inch extended desktop surface and casters with a side bag. It fits A4 and letter files and sits under the $60 mark.

It ranks sixth because the desktop adds work surface, but fabric fronts are less secure than metal. It beats the VASAGLE if you need a surface.

Best for a small workspace. The caveat is that the fabric fronts are not lockable.
products.idealFor: A small workspace that needs a surface.

products.name: BYNSOE 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Vertical Steel Filing Cabinet
products.verdict: A vertical steel cabinet with a lock that needs less side clearance.
products.description:
BYNSOE is a two-drawer vertical steel cabinet with a lock, fitting letter-size files. Assembly is required.

It ranks seventh because the steel and lock are good but assembly is required and only letter size is stated. It needs less side clearance than a lateral unit.

Best for a narrow wall. The caveat is the assembly.
products.idealFor: A narrow wall in a spare room.

products.name: SteeLoong 2 Drawer File Cabinet, Metal Office File Cabinet with Lock, Black
products.verdict: A standard two-drawer metal cabinet with a lock and no extras.
products.description:
SteeLoong is a two-drawer metal cabinet in black with a lock and a standard office design.

It ranks last because there are no standout features, though that also means no unneeded extras. It matches mid-tier pricing of similar cabinets.

Best for someone who wants a plain cabinet. The caveat is no distinguishing detail.

whatMatters.factor: Choose the shape for your room
whatMatters.detail: Vertical drawers need room in front, lateral drawers need width, and rolling cabinets need to slide under a desk. Measure the clearance in the spot first.
Letter is standard in the US, legal is longer, and A4 is the international size. Check the listing for the sizes you file.
If you store tax files or IDs, choose a locking drawer. Fabric fronts are not lockable.
Steel cabinets are heavy to assemble. Fully assembled cabinets like the Letaya and DEVAISE save time.
Casters let you roll a cabinet out of the way. Check that the casters lock.

faq.q: What is the best filing cabinet for a small office?
faq.a: An under-desk model like the DEVAISE 2-drawer or Letaya 3-drawer, which tuck away and roll out for access.
For financial or personal documents, yes. The Letaya, DEVAISE 2-drawer, BYNSOE and SteeLoong list locks.

faq.q: What is a lateral file cabinet?
faq.a: One whose drawers are wide and open sideways. It needs less front clearance than a vertical cabinet.
The Letaya and DEVAISE models list letter, legal and A4. The VASAGLE and BYNSOE do not list legal.

faq.q: Can a filing cabinet double as a printer stand?
faq.a: The VASAGLE CUSTOS is designed for it. Check weight limits.
The Letaya 3-drawer and DEVAISE 2-drawer list full assembly. The BYNSOE requires assembly.

finalTake: For most home offices, the Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet is the right buy: assembled, locking and rolling. For a tight space, take the DEVAISE 2-drawer. For a printer corner, the VASAGLE CUSTOS is the lowest price. For a narrow room, the Letaya lateral model needs less front clearance.
